vibe: Notion and Linear inspired. Highly analytical, objective, clean, and premium SaaS. Optimizes for clarity and trust over decoration.

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-24 for marketing sections. Tight spacing (p-4 to p-6) for dashboard components.
spacing_and_layout.marketing_grid: Tetris Grid (asymmetrical). Avoid default Bootstrap columns. Use overlapping layers and generous negative space.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Control Room Grid. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Strict hierarchy, dense data correlation.

surface_treatment.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px border (border-border), rounded-xl, subtle shadow-sm. No heavy gradients.
surface_treatment.header: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80, 1px bottom border border-border/40.

components.strategy: Shadcn/UI heavily customized for a flat, high-contrast look.
components.buttons: Square or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Dark mode style CTA (bg-black text-white hover:bg-zinc-800).
components.inputs: Shadcn Form/Input components. Light gray background (bg-zinc-50) on focus:bg-white.
components.charts: Shadcn Charts (Recharts). Use monochrome for structure, status colors (Emerald/Red) specifically for ATS match/fail metrics.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Crisp transformations. -translate-y-[2px], deeper shadow. All interactive elements must explicitly change text/bg color.
motion_and_interaction.metrics: Animated count-up for ATS score rings. Progress bars must fill dynamically.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='analyze-resume-btn').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast compliance. Hover states must be higher contrast. Do not rely solely on color for status (use icons alongside Red/Green/Yellow).

hero_abstract.usage: Marketing landing page hero background or side-visual. Abstract data processing.

desk_focus.usage: Section background for 'How it Works' or 'Recruiter Analysis'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Cabinet Grotesk (from Fontshare or local assets) and Manrope (Google Fonts). Apply them strictly.
Do not use placeholder text or mock images. Use the provided image URLs.
Implement the landing page with standard HTML/Tailwind to allow overlap, and use Shadcn extensively for the Resume Analysis Dashboard.
Build the dashboard modularly (Bento Grid style) for ATS Score, Recruiter Readiness, AI Tone Detection, and Keyword Match.
Adhere to the exact color tokens (Emerald for Match, Red for Gap/Fail). Do not introduce unapproved gradients.
Add 'data-testid' to every actionable button, link, and major output container.
